title: Seven Nation Army
lyrics:
[00:16.18]I'm gonna fight 'em off
[00:19.58]A seven nation army couldn't hold me back
[00:23.87]They're gonna rip it off
[00:27.38]Taking their time right behind my back
[00:31.66]And I'm talkin' to myself at night
[00:34.54]Because I can't forget
[00:39.99]Back and forth through my mind
[00:42.27]Behind a cigarette
[00:47.10]And the message comin' from my eyes says leave it alone
[01:26.90]Don't wanna hear about it
[01:30.57]Every single one's got a story to tell
[01:34.71]Everyone knows about it
[01:38.24]From the Queen of England to the hounds of Hell
[01:42.49]And if I catch you comin' back my way
[01:45.49]I'm gonna serve it to you
[01:50.72]And that ain't what you want to hear
[01:53.25]But that's what I'll do
[01:58.13]And the feeling comin' from my bones says find a home
[02:53.55]I'm going to Wichita
[02:57.15]Far from this opera forevermore
[03:01.35]I'm gonna work the straw
[03:04.85]Make the sweat drip out of every pore
[03:09.29]And I'm bleeding, and I'm bleeding, and I'm bleeding
[03:12.45]Right before the Lord
[03:17.12]All the words are gonna bleed from me
[03:19.87]And I will think no more
[03:25.04]And the stains comin' from my blood tell me, "Go back home"
